title: Return Charges on Payout Methods: Desk Reference and Booking Tool
content:
On Payout Methods, a transfer that the receiving bank or rail sends back carries one return charge, booked as a returned-payout fee against the method it was returned to and naming the return record; it falls due on the day of the return and is booked once per return, and it is worked out on the latest return on the method, the one it names.

## The return record and the charge

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| What carries a return charge | A transfer sent back by the receiving bank or rail, recorded on the method's ledger as a return |
| Which method is charged | The method the transfer was returned to |
| What the charge names | The return record |
| When it falls due | On the day of the return |
| How often | Once per return |
| Which return it is worked out on | The latest return on the method, the one the charge names |

**Hypothetical timing.** An imagined International Wire Transfer to a Canadian bank comes back on 2026-08-04. The return charge falls due on 2026-08-04, the day of the return, and names that return record.

## Effect of booking

Once booked, the return charge stands on the method's ledger as its own entry and is taken out of the method's undisbursed balance, which drops by exactly the charge. The method's status, its details and every other entry stay as they are. The host sees the charge as its own line in the payout history.

## Booking tool: `book_return_charge_692b7e7b`

**Situation of use and capability.** The tool posts the charge that a transfer sent back by the receiving bank or rail carries. One call adds one fee entry of kind `returned_payout_fee` to the payout method's ledger, dated today, naming the return record it belongs to and carrying the amount given.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_return_charge_692b7e7b` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payout_method_id` | The reference number of the payout method the transfer was returned to, exactly as returned by the payout-method lookup | Id |
| `source_event_id` | The reference number of the return record (the returned transfer as booked back to the method) that the charge belongs to, exactly as shown by the payout ledger lookup | Id |
| `amount` | The return charge as a positive USD amount, already rounded as the charge policy prescribes | Fixed format, 2 decimal places; stored rounded to 2 decimal places and never changed otherwise |

**Return.** A text rendering of a record with `payout_txn_id` (the reference number of the new charge entry), `payout_method_id` (the method charged), `source_event_id` (the return record the charge belongs to), `fee_type` (always `returned_payout_fee`), `amount` (the USD charge booked, 2 decimal places), `posted_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today) and `status`. The call has succeeded when `status` comes back as "booked".
